name: Four Seasons Hotel Buenos Aires
positioning: Luxury hotel pairing an early 20th-century mansion with a modern tower in Recoleta
best_for: Couples and food lovers who want steak and asado
Travelers who like historic architecture with modern comfort
First-time visitors who want a walkable Recoleta base

facts.text: The hotel is at Posadas 1086/88 in the Recoleta neighbourhood of Buenos Aires.
It has 165 guest rooms, including 49 suites, in two wings: a 12-story main tower and the historic mansion wing, which houses suites.
The mansion was built in the Belle Époque style in 1920 as a wedding gift from Felix Alzaga Unzué to his wife Elena Peña.
The hotel opened in 1992 as the Park Hyatt Buenos Aires. Four Seasons took over management in 2001.
A $49 million renovation was completed in 2013.
Elena is a two-storey steakhouse built around dry-aged meats, brasserie cuisine and charcuterie, selected by the Michelin Guide and listed among the 101 Best Steak Restaurants in the World.
Nuestro Secreto serves outdoor Argentinian barbecue, and Pony Line is a polo-inspired lounge with creative cocktails and burgers.
Cielo Spa offers a signature Tango Porteño massage, a steam bath and sauna, and relaxation rooms.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours for in-house guests.
Dogs and cats under 25 pounds are welcome.

highlights.text: The heated outdoor pool sits in the middle of the gardens, with food and drink delivered to your deck chair. The hotel says it is the only outdoor swimming pool in the Recoleta area.
A Sunday asado is held as an afternoon firepit barbecue in the secret garden.
Elena has been recognised on Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants list.
Guests can book a one-hour private tango lesson with a professional dancer, from USD 75 per person.
The mansion holds suites including the Presidential Suite, with Slavonian oak floors, three crystal chandeliers and a terrace over the gardens.

considerations.text: Pricing is premium, in line with its luxury positioning.
The atmosphere is formal and may not suit every traveler.
The pool is open 8:00 am to 7:00 pm, and spa treatments run 10:00 am to 8:00 pm.
The hotel has two wings: a 12-story tower and the historic mansion, which houses the suites, so room type determines whether you stay in the old building or the new one.
